Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
Yes, I know this may seem like a stupid question, but if I knew the answer, I
wouldn't be asking. (well, I kinda know the answer, but I just want to be
sure).

Can other (untapped) vamps play an action mod that does not refer to the fact
that the acting vamp must play it (eg Day Op)?

For example, could an acting Nos play Lost in Crowds then if the stealth is
needed, could a second vamp play Lost in Crowds? Does this tap the 2nd vamp?

Could other vamps other than the acting play mods like Bewitching Oration or
Business Pressure? Or bribes? Does this tap the 2nd vamp?

What about Threats, Bonding or any mod that increases bleeds? (keeping regard
to the restrictions imposed by the 2 above named cards)

Can a 2nd (much older) vamp play Seduction for the (much younger) acting vamp?

thanx,
Sorrow

Messages.Author: James Hamblin
Messages.Body:
Only the acting minion may play action modifiers, with the only
exceptions (as far as I know) being Hidden Lurker and Cloak the
Gathering.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
cbo...@apdi.net (Sorrow) writes:
>Can other (untapped) vamps play an action mod that does not refer to the fact
>that the acting vamp must play it (eg Day Op)?

No. All Action Mods can only be played by the acting minion *unless* it
refers to the fact that it can be played by a minion other than the
acting minion (eg Cloak the Gathering).

>For example, could an acting Nos play Lost in Crowds then if the stealth is
>needed, could a second vamp play Lost in Crowds? Does this tap the 2nd vamp?

>Could other vamps other than the acting play mods like Bewitching Oration or
>Business Pressure? Or bribes? Does this tap the 2nd vamp?

>What about Threats, Bonding or any mod that increases bleeds? (keeping regard
>to the restrictions imposed by the 2 above named cards)

>Can a 2nd (much older) vamp play Seduction for the (much younger) acting vamp?

"No" to all of these examples.
